name: handoff
description: Saves working notes before the chat is summarized to free its memory (compact) and offers them back after; when the memory is nearly full it asks once: summarize now or hand off to a fresh chat

threshold.title: Threshold (%)
threshold.description: Ask once (summarize now, or hand off to a fresh chat) when the chat's memory is this full, 50 to 99; five points before the automatic summary instead when that comes sooner

summarize.title: Summarize with Haiku
summarize.description: Add a short 'where we are / next step' summary to each note: one call to Haiku, a small and cheap model, per handoff. Off: the note is built from the session alone, at no cost
